entries.claim: Rank disease-associated targets by overall association score from the Open Targets Platform API
Retrieve bounded evidence rows with discriminated datasource and datatype semantics
Paginate API results within configurable budgets with completeness labels
Generate one provider-styled canonical PDF report with deterministic figures and a GenerateImage infographic

capabilities.trigger: Use when prioritizing therapeutic targets for a disease using the Open Targets Platform GraphQL API.

choices.label: Evidence plus GWAS credible sets and L2G

clarification_questions.prompt: Only if the prompt does not already determine scope: should the analysis inspect credible sets and L2G predictions for a GWAS study, or retrieve evidence only for the top target?

headline_definitions.definition: The count of all disease-associated targets reported by the API for the queried EFO ID
headline_definitions.name: total_associated_targets

headline_definitions.definition: An integrated prioritization metric (0-1) combining multiple evidence datasources; not an effect estimate
headline_definitions.name: overall_association_score

headline_definitions.definition: Whether the retrieved target set is exhaustive or a bounded sample
headline_definitions.name: completeness

facts.partition_not_applicable_reason: The target ranking is a bounded sample, not an exhaustive partition; retrieved rows do not sum to the total associated target count, so sum_members_equals_denominator accounting does not apply.

inference_readiness.not_applicable_reason: This skill retrieves and prioritizes target-disease associations from a public API; it performs no statistical inference, hypothesis testing, or experimental design. Association scores are integrated prioritization metrics, not inferential estimates requiring experimental-unit or design-identifiability gates.

resource_identity.not_applicable_reason: The Open Targets Platform GraphQL API is the authoritative source for all retrieved data; this skill queries it directly and does not match records against a separate local authoritative copy. Resource identity verification against a second source is not applicable.

caveats.statement: Association scores are integrated prioritization metrics, not effect estimates, replication, causal proof, or clinical validation.
The target sample is bounded, not exhaustive; do not label bounded samples as exhaustive.
L2G and colocalisation records carry null datasource_id with an explicit not-applicable reason.

Infographic provenance is reported as a fail-closed three-state outcome: verified, not_evaluable_platform_trace (a genuine GenerateImage event whose proof is truncated/id-less/agent-writable/hashless in the platform trace), or failed. A not_evaluable state is never presented as verified and is release-blocking unless facts, provenance, and the report all disclose that provenance is not independently verified.

data_sources.license: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication) for data; API free with no authentication
data_sources.name: Open Targets Platform GraphQL API

inputs: An EFO disease ID (e.g. MONDO_0004975 for Alzheimer disease)
Optionally a GWAS Catalog study ID (e.g. GCST005194)
Optionally the number of top targets to retrieve (default 10)

workflow.instruction: Pass the complete user prompt to scripts/prompt_contract.py. Execute immediately when status is ready; ask only the single unresolved field when status is clarify. Never ask for confirmation, alternative values, or validation depth already fixed by the prompt.
workflow.title: Resolve supplied inputs without redundant clarification

workflow.instruction: Run the meta query to capture dataVersion and apiVersion, binding them to the operation ledger.
workflow.title: Capture API release metadata

workflow.instruction: Query associatedTargets for the given EFO ID, retrieving a bounded top-N set with datatype scores.
workflow.title: Resolve disease identity and rank targets

workflow.instruction: Query evidences for the top-ranked target with cursor pagination, bounded by configured budgets.
workflow.title: Retrieve evidence for the top target

workflow.instruction: Query study metadata and credible sets with L2G and colocalisation for the given study ID. Before integrating the study, check concordance between the study's returned trait/ontology and the queried disease; non-concordant studies are labeled independent_study_context.
workflow.title: Inspect GWAS study and credible sets

workflow.instruction: Pass all records through semantics.py serializers with record_type, metric, scale, datasource_id, and interpretation boundary.
workflow.title: Serialize records through the discriminated schema

workflow.instruction: Run visualize.py to produce the target-ranking bar chart and datatype heatmap from report_facts.json.
workflow.title: Build deterministic figures

workflow.instruction: Call the Biomni GenerateImage tool with the fixed prompt from assets/infographic_prompt.txt to produce the workflow infographic. Read the prompt immediately before calling GenerateImage; do not edit it afterward. The prompt and image SHA256 are derived into provenance and receipt.
workflow.title: Generate the qualitative infographic

workflow.instruction: Derive report_content.json and report_structure.json from the gated facts and provenance. Resolve the report-style provider from immutable user messages, render exactly one canonical PDF through that provider, and finalize lineage only after the completed PDF is staged. The bundled build_report.py renderer is default-provider-only.
workflow.title: Build the provider-styled canonical PDF report

workflow.instruction: Extract text, render pages, record visual review attestation with pdf_sha256 and artifact_sha256s, and write receipt v3 with provider-specific style verification plus infographic lineage verification.
workflow.title: Record PDF review and write the run receipt

starting_task.decision_context: target identification and prioritization for drug discovery using public integrated association evidence
starting_task.deliverables: target_ranking.csv, evidence_rows.csv, operation_ledger.json, report_facts.json, deterministic figures, infographic_open_targets_workflow.png generated with GenerateImage, and report_open-targets.pdf
starting_task.objective: Prioritize therapeutic targets for Alzheimer disease (MONDO_0004975) using the Open Targets Platform GraphQL API.
starting_task.subject_input: Alzheimer disease (MONDO_0004975), a bounded top-10 target ranking, and GWAS Catalog study GCST005194 with credible sets

auto.note: test_count is the full offline pytest suite collected count (all assets/eval/test_*.py modules). Offline evals cover frozen fixtures and rejection mutations, including deterministic prompt readiness, prompt/image lineage, content-identity embedding, PDF hash binding, operation counts, concordance, strict JSON, (R3) transcript-normalization for both supported native schemas (typed tool_use/tool_result and flattened assistant.tool_calls[]/type:tool), and (R4) the three-state infographic-lineage outcome (verified / not_evaluable_platform_trace / failed) with its cross-surface disclosure contract for platform-truncated GenerateImage args.
